status: Exploratory reuse of seed20261018, all32 banks and12 conditions; not fresh confirmation
split: Each of three existing outer folds in turn:64 train,32 independent aggregation. Report average risk of the three procedures, not risk of averaging their predictions; each procedure uses96 labels.
bound: A=1.6 for all three signal functions; known sigma. B=A+sigma*sqrt(2log32). Clip candidate predictions and aggregation responses to[-B,B]. Evaluate original unbounded-response mean risk. Known A is extra information and is disclosed.
candidate_pool: All checkpoints up to horizon plus their equal-weight average. Individual checkpoints clipped first; uniform candidate averages clipped checkpoints. No test-dependent pruning.
algorithm: Uniform prior over candidates, eta=1/(8B²); progressive mixture over32 aggregation observations in original row order. No temperature tuning or post-aggregation refit.
comparators: Same frozen clipped candidates: holdout convex stacking, holdout single selection, uniform checkpoint average, last checkpoint. Full96-label baselines: cached CV3, last, uniform, adaptive, last-or-uniform. Equal labels, not equal compute or information.
report: All conditions and independent-bank paired SE; theory constants and clipping frequency. No claim of significance or high-probability superiority.
